name: Mt. Taibo in the Style of Wang Meng
material: handscroll; ink and light color on paper
summary: When a Chinese painter "imitated" a painting by a past master, the intention was never to produce an exact copy. Du Qiong, the Ming painter from Suzhou, is a case in point.
